title: Synergistic steric–dipole modulation via stepwise trifluoromethyl substitution enables active-layer hierarchical assembly and >20% power conversion efficiency in organic photovoltaic devices
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07321A, Paper
Jie Wang, Xin Chen, Jingyi Huo, Jiong Yang, Longyu Li, Wendi Shi, Ruibin Bian, Wenkai Zhao, Guankui Long, Zhaoyang Yao, Chenxi Li, Xiangjian Wan, Yongsheng Chen
A stepwise trifluoromethyl substitution strategy is developed for the structural modification of small-molecule acceptors. The device based on –C(CF3)3 functionalized CHE-9F achieves an efficiency of 20.30%.
